not_brought: Keyfleet's home (/keyfleet stays regents.sh's own page in this slice), every fleet page, the sidebar's fleet entries and the share picture: they read fleets and come with slice 2.
The sea behind the page (HarbourSeaLive, the :harbour_sea pipeline) and its hooks: it reads fleet state.
The header's Buy Key offer and window (get_key, BuyKey): it needs a fleet's sale and a wallet; it is left out whole, not disabled.
Keyfleet's account menu (paired agents, Pair New Agent, the pairing window), sign-in events, mutes and session lease re-checks (Live.Session): this site's account control stands in, without its menu.
The Agent Message button and window on /keyfleet/agents, with its three copy buttons: it needs a stored message, an account and a session lease, and this site has no such component.
openapi.json, commands.json, capabilities.json and the contract YAML: they describe the API and come with it.
/.well-known/ addresses, /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml: root addresses, regents.sh's. The agent-skills index and zip need the root index.
/metadata/ and hub-jwks.json: the keyfleet.ai host, at the move.

Keyfleet's root and early layouts, the launch gate and the early-access page, sign-in, sessions, accounts, actors, agents and pairing, Points, messages, endpoint, router, release and database setup, telemetry, vitals, visit log, steps, error tracking and rate limiting: this site's own serve every page.
